description: This file defines functions and parameters for battery modeling using the PyBaMM library, including data loading, interpolant functions, electrochemical parameter calculations, and default parameter setup.

methods.name: Up_fun
methods.description: Returns an interpolant for the positive electrode open-circuit potential based on loaded CSV data.

methods.name: Un_fun
methods.description: Returns an interpolant for the negative electrode open-circuit potential based on loaded CSV data.

methods.name: Positive_exchange_current
methods.description: Calculates the positive electrode exchange current density using Arrhenius equation.

methods.name: Negative_exchange_current
methods.description: Calculates the negative electrode exchange current density using Arrhenius equation.

methods.name: Positive_diffusivity
methods.description: Computes the diffusivity in the positive electrode as a temperature-dependent Arrhenius process.

methods.name: Negative_diffusivity
methods.description: Computes the diffusivity in the negative electrode as a temperature-dependent Arrhenius process.

methods.name: get_default_param
methods.description: Returns a set of default battery parameters, including physical properties and functions.
